description: This file defines a utility for limiting JPEG image size by adjusting quality and scale factors. It includes data structures and algorithms to compress images to a specified maximum byte size efficiently.

classes.name: JpegSizeLimiterResult
classes.description: Data class holding compressed image bytes, dimensions, and quality.

classes.name: JpegSizeLimiter
classes.description: Singleton object containing the method for compressing images to meet size constraints.

methods.name: compressToLimit
methods.description: Compresses an image to fit within maxBytes by adjusting quality and scale iteratively.
